summary.text: Nick Langworthy is the Republican and Conservative incumbent in NY-23, first elected to the House in 2022. A Western New York native, he worked as a congressional district-office staffer and founded a polling firm before chairing the Erie County Republican Committee and then the New York Republican State Committee. He serves on the Energy and Commerce, Oversight and Government Reform, and Rules committees, and his office describes his focus as constituent service, jobs and economic opportunity, and protecting constitutional rights.

paragraphs.text: Langworthy was born in Jamestown, New York, and attended Pine Valley Central School. According to his congressional office, his upbringing included working in his family's bar and restaurant business. He earned a bachelor's degree in political science and government from Niagara University in 2003.

He began his career in the district office of former Rep. Tom Reynolds and later served as district office director for Rep. Chris Lee. He also founded and ran the polling firm Liberty Opinion Research.
Langworthy became chairman of the Erie County Republican Committee in 2010 and chairman of the New York Republican State Committee in 2019, a post he held until his election to Congress.

Langworthy was elected in 2022 to represent New York's 23rd District, which covers Western New York and the Southern Tier, and took office in 2023, succeeding Rep. Joe Sempolinski. He serves on the House Energy and Commerce Committee, with seats on its Health and Energy and Environment subcommittees, as well as the Oversight and Government Reform Committee and the Rules Committee. In the 119th Congress he chairs the Rules Committee's Legislative and Budget Process Subcommittee.

According to his office, he was a leader during House consideration of the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024 on airline safety measures adopted after the Colgan Air Flight 3407 crash in Clarence, New York. He co-chairs the Maple Caucus and belongs to the Northern Border Security Caucus and the Rural Health Caucus, among other congressional caucuses.
His office states that Langworthy and his wife, Erin, live in Pendleton, New York, with their son and daughter.
